Лила — древняя индийская игра-практика с: Leela is an ancient Indian game of self-discovery. Before playing, you set a question or intention. Your journey across the board then becomes a mirror of where you get stuck and what helps you move forward.
Игра начинается с ожидания: фишка выходи: The game begins with a wait: your token enters the board only when you roll a 6. This is called birth. After that, each six gives you another roll, so a single turn may contain several rolls.
Поле — это путь из 72 клеток, свёрнутый: The board is a winding path of 72 squares. Your token moves forward by the number you roll. There is no opponent: the aim is to travel the path to its end.
На некоторых клетках прячутся змеи и стр: Some squares have snakes or arrows. A snake activates when your turn ends on its square and takes your token down: a lesson to reflect on. An arrow lifts your token forward, suggesting a breakthrough or unexpected help. Squares you simply pass over do not activate.
У каждой клетки есть свой текст. Читай е: Each square has its own text. Read it in the context of your intention. This reflection is the heart of the practice, rather than simply moving on and forgetting the square.
Партия заканчивается, как только фишка п: The game ends as soon as your token lands exactly on the finish square, whether through a normal move, a snake or an arrow. You can then view a summary of your journey.
Leela is an ancient game of spiritual growth. You set an intention, and the rolls of the die guide your token across a board that mirrors your journey.
